title.narrative: Protection and assistance to refugees and asylum-seekers in Libya 2022-2024

description.narrative: This action is a continuation of the previous support provided by the EU Emergency Trust Fund for Africa (EUTF) to UNHCR Libya since mid- 2017 under multiple phases, as well through the EUTF grants relating to the Emergency Transit Mechanisms (ETMs) in Niger and Rwanda. This current action is focusing on specific activities with priority for assistance to PoCs living in urban settings in line with activities focusing on UNHCR¿s goal to end arbitrary detention for refugees and asylum-seekers.
